store.name: Taller Ñandú
store.tagline: Handmade mate gear from Buenos Aires, shipped worldwide
store.shipping_policy: Ships worldwide from Buenos Aires in 2 business days. Tracked international mail takes 7-12 business days. Free shipping on orders of 60.00 USD or more, otherwise a flat 9.00 USD.
store.returns_policy: Unused items can be returned within 30 days. Broken-on-arrival items are refunded in full after a photo.
store.hours: Mon-Sat 9:00-19:00 (Buenos Aires time). The assistant answers 24/7.
